gui.qwertys_billboard.title: Edit Billboard
gui.qwertys_billboard.name: Name
gui.qwertys_billboard.hint_empty: Press [Add image] at the bottom left, or drop image files onto this window.
gui.qwertys_billboard.tip.move_step: Step for +/- buttons and mouse wheel (position, size, depth)
gui.qwertys_billboard.tip.rot_step: Rotation step for +/- and mouse wheel. Any value (e.g. 0.01°) can be typed.
gui.qwertys_billboard.tip.reset: Reset position and rotation of the selection (or the whole group).
gui.qwertys_billboard.tip.mode3d: 2D: flat plate / 3D: extruded along the image outline by the depth
gui.qwertys_billboard.tip.glow: Always rendered at full brightness. Raise 'Light' to actually light up the area.
gui.qwertys_billboard.tip.facing: Rotate the whole billboard by 90°. WorldEdit //rotate rotates this too.
gui.qwertys_billboard.tip.color_mode: Original / Tinted / Solid / Rainbow / Rainbow wave / Rainbow tint
gui.qwertys_billboard.tip.add: Pick images from your PC (multiple allowed). You can also drop files onto the window.
gui.qwertys_billboard.tip.replace: Replace only the image, keeping position, rotation and appearance.
gui.qwertys_billboard.tip.split: Split shapes that are not touching into separate objects, keeping their positions.
gui.qwertys_billboard.tip.resolution: Max pixels on the long side when importing.
gui.qwertys_billboard.tip.remove_bg: For images without transparency (JPG...), remove the solid background connected to the edges. Transparent PNG/SVG areas are always removed.
gui.qwertys_billboard.dialog_filter: Images (PNG, JPG, GIF, BMP, WEBP, TIFF, TGA, PSD, ICO, SVG)
gui.qwertys_billboard.status.dialog_fail: Could not open the file dialog. Drop image files onto this window instead.
gui.qwertys_billboard.status.too_big: Too much data. Lower the resolution.
gui.qwertys_billboard.status.select_firs: Select an object in the list first.
gui.qwertys_billboard.status.shift_clear: Hold Shift and click to delete all objects.
msg.qwertys_billboard.error: An error occurred while editing the billboard.
msg.qwertys_billboard.too_far: You are too far from the billboard.
msg.qwertys_billboard.no_permission: You may not edit this billboard.
msg.qwertys_billboard.too_many_parts: A billboard block can hold at most %s objects.
msg.qwertys_billboard.too_large: Total image data %sKB exceeds the limit of %sKB.
msg.qwertys_billboard.image_too_big: Image %sx%s exceeds the server limit of %spx.
